page.layout: Two columns of a Hebrew-Latin lexicon, separated by a vertical rule. Left column: head "קט", entries, a centred section letter "ק׳", more entries. Right column: head "ק׳", then entries to the bottom. Printed page number 376 at top left. Running head in Hebrew at top centre. No margin notes, no catchword, no signature.

main_text.head: קט
main_text.p: קָט fastidivit, fastidium, præt. Kal, 3. f. m. vel No. f. m. Rad. קוּט.
קָטָן parvus, קְטַנָּה parva, קְטַנִּי · קְטַנִּים parvi, קְטַנּוֹת parvæ, No. f. & pl. m. & f. Rad. קָטַן parvum esse.
קָטֹן parvus, קְטָנִּי meus, sing. m. constr. aff. No. קָטֶן; Rad. קָטַן.
קִיא vomitus, בְּקִיאוֹ in vomitu suo, No. f. m. præf. aff. Rad. קוּא vomuit.
קִיאוּ & vomite, Jer. 25.27. Imper. Kal, pl. m. (pro קִיאוּ, qu. à Rad. קָאָה mutando א in י) Rad. קוּא.
קִיטוֹר fumus, No. f. m. Rad. קִטֵּר suffivit.
קִים substantia, קִימְנוּ nostra, קִיָּמָה surrectio,
main_text.head: ק׳
main_text.p: קִיפָּם eorum, No. f. m. & f. aff. Rad. קוּם surrexit.
קִים stabilivit, præt. Piel, 3. f. m. & קִים erige, קִימֵנִי me, Imper. Piel, f. m. aff. Rad. קוּם.
קִימוּשׁ carduus, No. f. m. Rad. קמש.
קִינָה lamentatio, קִינוֹת. קִינִים lamentationes, No. f. & pl. f. & m. Rad. קוּן lamentatus est.
קִינוֹ lancea ejus, sing. masc. aff. No. Rad. קִין.
קִיץ æstas, קִיצָהּ æstivi fructus tui, Jer. 16.9. (pro קִיצְךָ,) No. f. & pl. m. aff. Rad. קִין tædere.
קִיצוֹן extremus, קִיצוֹנָה extrema, No. sing. m. & f. Rad. קָצָה abscidit.
קִיקָיוֹן ricinus, No. f. m. à Rad. inusit. קִיק.
קִיקָלוֹן vomitus ignominiæ, No. f. m. comp. ex No. קִיא vomitus, à Rad. קִיא evomuit, & No.

page.notes: Hebrew glyphs are copied from a small, partly blurred scan; vowel points and some letters are doubtful and are not individually marked. Entry "קִיקִיּוֹן" and the root in "קִיק" are especially uncertain. The Jer. 16.9 form "קִיצְךָ" in parentheses is reconstructed from a faint line. The section letter "ק׳" in the left column is printed centred between entries and is kept as a paragraph; the top "קט" and right-column "ק׳" are centred section heads. The running head is Hebrew and copied as far as legible. The last line of the right column continues beyond the page.
